reuse.why: Reuses the existing upgrading-account lookup in linkBankSyncAccount (hoisted, not re-queried) and the shared link path every provider goes through.

duplication.why: The account fetch is moved rather than copied, and the closed check exists once.

placement.why: The check sits in the shared linkBankSyncAccount core used by all six providers, before any side effect; the existing withBankAccountLinkGuard precondition wrapper would have been an equally natural home.

scope.why: Only the precondition, the hoisted lookup and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: A single early guard ahead of bank creation, sync and events is easy to read and to own.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount, which every provider link handler calls
